name: Melanin pigment synthesis and pigment granule localization
rationale: All members concern melanin production (MITF-M pigmentation genes, melanin biosynthesis, SLC24A5 albinism, secondary-metabolite regulation) or pigment granule positioning, unlike confusables centred on UV/melanocyte proliferation, melanosome biogenesis, lysosomal acidification or non-pigment MITF-M targets.

core: Mycobacterium tuberculosis manipulation of host cell
qualifier: iron and heme scavenging, host defence suppression
name: M. tuberculosis iron scavenging and host-defence suppression
rationale: Members are Mtb strategies for nutrient (iron, heme, energy, ions) acquisition and for suppressing apoptosis, autophagy and nitric oxide, whereas confusables focus on phagosome maturation blockade, membrane repair inhibition and toxin uptake.

name: Viral protein maturation and virion assembly
rationale: All members cover post-translational processing of viral proteins (spike, DENV) and their assembly at the budding site, while all confusables concern viral attachment and entry.

qualifier: synthesis, gamma-glutamyl turnover, cystine supply and inherited defects
name: Glutathione synthesis, turnover and cystine supply
rationale: Members cover glutathione synthesis/recycling and catabolism, its enzyme deficiencies (GCLC, GSS, GGT1, OPLAH, ACY1), cystine/glutamate supply and ferroptosis protection, distinct from confusables on transsulfuration, selenium/sulfide metabolism and general ROS detoxification.

qualifier: BAX/BAK permeabilization and apoptosome-SMAC caspase activation
name: Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization and apoptosome activation
rationale: All members cover BAX/BAK-driven MOMP, cytochrome c release, apoptosome caspase activation and SMAC antagonism of IAPs, whereas confusables add BH3-only activators (BIM, BMF, BID, NOXA, PUMA).

qualifier: alveolar pneumocyte differentiation and surfactant homeostasis
name: Lung alveolar development and surfactant homeostasis
rationale: Members span lung branching, lobe and saccule growth, pneumocyte differentiation and surfactant metabolism with its disorders, while confusables emphasise trachea, diaphragm, lung mesenchyme or other branching organs.

name: Cardiomyocyte depolarization and His-Purkinje conduction
rationale: Members concern phase 0 depolarization in atrial, ventricular and AV-node cells and His-Purkinje-ventricular signalling, distinct from confusables on repolarization, gap-junction coupling and SA-node pacemaking.

name: Angiogenic growth factor production and sprouting angiogenesis promotion
rationale: Members regulate VEGF, FGF and TGF-beta2 production and promote endothelial proliferation, migration and vessel sprouting, unlike confusables on angiogenesis inhibition, Tie/VEGFR2 receptor signalling or endothelial activation and apoptosis.

name: Sweet, bitter and umami taste perception
rationale: All members are perception of sweet, bitter or umami taste, distinct from confusables on sour taste, acid sensing and olfaction.

qualifier: FGFR, ERBB and MET via RAS-MAPK and PI3K
name: FGFR, ERBB and MET signaling through RAS-MAPK and PI3K
rationale: Members are growth-factor RTK (FGFR, ERBB/EGFR, MET, IGF1R, ALK/LTK) signalling and its RAS-RAF-MAPK and PI3K-AKT relays including oncogenic RAS/RAF mutants, while confusables emphasise ERK5/serine phosphorylation, RTK fusions/amplifications or AKT2 metabolic effects.

name: Redox homeostasis, NADPH supply and ferroptosis control
rationale: Members cover ROS detoxification, NADPH/isocitrate metabolism, glutathione and cystine transport and ferroptosis regulation, distinct from confusables on NFE2L2 regulation, glutathione synthesis defects, NADP biosynthesis or ascorbate/BH4 metabolism.

core: Heavy metal ion transport and detoxification
name: Copper, cadmium and manganese transport and detoxification
rationale: All members concern transport, homeostasis or detoxification of copper, cadmium or manganese, while confusables centre on iron/heme, zinc transport or metallothionein-MTF1 responses.

qualifier: biosynthesis, vesicular loading and transporter reuptake
name: Catecholamine synthesis with monoamine vesicular loading and reuptake
rationale: Members cover dopamine/norepinephrine synthesis, vesicular loading, release and SLC6 reuptake of catecholamines and serotonin, distinct from confusables on monoamine degradation, serotonin synthesis or vesicle acidification.

qualifier: GABA turnover and GABA/glycine synaptic transport
name: GABA turnover and inhibitory GABA-glycine synaptic transmission
rationale: Members cover GABA synthesis, degradation, secretion and reuptake plus glycinergic transmission, whereas confusables concern glutamate and aspartate transport.

name: TGF-beta-SMAD2/3 signaling and SMAD-regulated miRNA biogenesis
rationale: Members cover TGF-beta receptor and SMAD2/3:SMAD4 signalling and its downregulation plus miRNA transcription and processing, unlike confusables on BMP, RUNX3, TGFBR3/activin or fibrotic outcomes.

name: Cilium assembly, intraflagellar transport and ciliary motility
rationale: Members span basal body docking, IFT, ciliary cargo targeting, axoneme and dynein arm assembly and motile-cilia functions (mucociliary clearance, CSF flow, sperm motility), distinct from confusables on left/right patterning, photoreceptors, sperm mitochondria or tubulin modification.

name: Primitive streak gastrulation and mesendodermal cell migration
rationale: Members cover primitive streak formation, gastrulation EMT and mesodermal migration, germ-layer formation and pluripotency exit, distinct from confusables on definitive endoderm, cardiac mesoderm or lateral plate mesoderm.

name: Norepinephrine and epinephrine biosynthesis
rationale: All three members concern synthesis of norepinephrine and epinephrine, without the dopamine synthesis, degradation or transport present in confusables.

qualifier: adenylate cyclase synthesis and phosphodiesterase degradation in neurons
name: Neuronal adenylate cyclase cAMP synthesis and degradation
rationale: Members concern cAMP production by adenylate cyclases (dopamine receptor, calcium-stimulated ADCY1/8), its PDE1 degradation and DARPP-32/CREB outputs, whereas confusables centre on PKA activation and cellular responses to cAMP.

qualifier: chamber, septum and valve formation with endocardial EMT
name: Cardiac chamber, septal and valve morphogenesis with endocardial EMT
rationale: Members cover ventricular/atrial myocardium, trabeculation, septation and valve formation via endocardial cushion EMT, distinct from confusables on coronary vasculature, early heart tube/second heart field or outflow arteries.

qualifier: telomere protection and replication fork processing
name: Telomere protection and replication fork stress response
rationale: Members concern telomere capping, replication and recombination-based maintenance plus fork reversal, R-loop and topological stress, intra-S checkpoint and responses to camptothecin/hydroxyurea, unlike confusables centred on canonical double-strand break repair.

name: Organic cation, polyamine and xenobiotic membrane transport
rationale: Members concern SLC-mediated transport of organic cations, polyamines (putrescine, spermidine) and xenobiotics including blood-brain barrier export, whereas confusables emphasise SLCO organic anion/drug ADME, bilirubin or dicarboxylate transport.

qualifier: positive regulation of IL-4, IL-5, IL-13
name: Th2 polarization promoting IL-4, IL-5 and IL-13 signaling
rationale: Members cover Th2 differentiation, positive regulation of IL-4/IL-5/IL-13 production and IL-4/IL-13 signalling, distinct from confusables on eosinophils, negative regulation of type 2 cytokines or IL-33.

name: TLR-induced TAK1 activation of JNK and p38
rationale: Members describe TRAF6/IRAK2/TRIF-dependent TAK1 complex induction and its activation of JNK and p38 stress kinases, whereas confusables centre on IKK recruitment and NF-kappaB or on negative MAPK regulation.

qualifier: hexosamine pathway UDP-GlcNAc and sialic acid
name: Hexosamine pathway UDP-GlcNAc and sialic acid metabolism
rationale: Members cover fructose-6-phosphate to UDP-GlcNAc synthesis, sialic acid metabolism and their defects (GFPT1, GNE, ALG14), distinct from confusables on nucleotide-sugar transport, mannose/GDP-mannose or glucose-based glycosylation precursors.
